content:
alana: Quick heads-up 9:30 PT deploy window for miniroot unprivilege rebase. Need RBAC review, KMS wrap verify, and audit smoke. Who's on? :eyes:
nate: I'll do RBAC preflight. Which SAs?
alana: runtime-runner, image-batcher, signer-bot. Dropping CAP_SYS_ADMIN from runtime-runner; signer moves to signer-bot with tight list/sign perms.
devin: I'll own KMS wrap/unwrap flow + cosign verify. Will dry-run in staging.
marco: I'll run a quick vuln check on the init image (busyinit:1.2). If risky, propose privileged-init canary fallback.
natalie: I'll validate audit-forwarding to Splunk and SIEM for trace id mr-4290001234.
sec-bot: automated: created runbook https://redwood-internal/runbooks/miniroot-unpriv and ticket SEC-8680
(5m later) marco: vuln-scan: busyinit flagged low-sev CVE needing local write. No network, exploitability low; patch ETA 40m.
nate: Staging RBAC test: removed cap and ran e2e 1. Pod failed at cgroup move. Init required.
alana: Ok plan: canary with privileged init only, main unpriv. Update runbook and ensure audit captures init image + pid.
devin: KMS dry-run: wrapped key created in staging; cosign verify OK. Cmd: COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign verify --key k8s://secret/keystore/staging/miniroot-pub.pem ghcr.io/redwood/miniroot:canary
natalie: Staging audit: events present with trace mr-4290001234, fields: request.user=system:serviceaccount:runtime:runtime-runner, init.image=ghcr.io/redwood/busyinit:1.2, cosign=true
ops-oncall: I'll monitor 19:30-20:30 PT, open #incident if errors >2x baseline.
(After canary) nate: Canary passed: main containers ran unpriv, init was privileged. No elevated shells observed.
alana: Good. Devin, proceed with prod keystore swap after you push wrapped key.
devin: Prod swap done, cosign verify OK.
sec-bot: automated: checklist updated [RBAC:true] [Audit:true] [KMS:true] [Vuln:patch-deferred]
alana: Follow-ups: 1) patch init and re-sign tomorrow 2) revoke privileged-init after patch 3) confirm audit retention windows. Thanks everyone.
